Part of [`evoxc.ir`](/api/evoxc/ir/)

The declared contract of one op.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — Registered op name (registry key).

- `category` · `str` — Grouping for documentation/routing (elementwise, comparison,
  structure, reduction, linalg, control, terminator, collective).

- `description` · `str` — One-line semantics.

- `arity` · `int | tuple[int, int | None]` — Exact operand count, or `(min, max)` with `None` = unbounded
  (variadic).

- `result_count` · `int | tuple[int, int | None] | None` — Exact result count, `(min, max)`, or `None` =
  unknown until built (op-specific resolution).

- `effect` · `str` — One of the `EFFECT_*` kinds (`effects.py`).

- `attributes` · `tuple[AttrSpec, ...]` — Declared attribute schema (`AttrSpec`s).

- `shape_fn` · `ShapeInferenceFn | None` — Shape-inference hook, or None (see module docstring).

- `regions` · `int` — Number of nested regions the op owns (0, 1, or 2).

- `is_terminator` · `bool` — True if the op terminates its block (`return`).

## check_arity

```python
check_arity(count: int) -> bool
```

True if `count` operands satisfy this op's arity.
